study.normalization: Median ratios to the across-sample geometric mean; genes positive in all 11 T2 mice; no length correction.
study.analysisType: Exploratory descriptive precursor-RNA comparison; no p-values or differential-expression claims.
study.unit: Independent male mouse pancreatic neoplastic lesion, T2 (90 days after orthotopic PaNIN lesion transplantation).
study.mainContrast: HFD + semaglutide (n=3 deposited) versus HFD (n=4); LFD (n=4) is context, not weight-loss matching.
study.depositionDiscrepancy: GEO protocol states planned n=4 per T2 group; only three SEMA columns/GSMs are deposited and analyzed.

selectionRules.effectFormula: log2[(mean normalized SEMA count + 1)/(mean normalized HFD count + 1)]
selectionRules.leaveOneOut: Omit each of the seven HFD/SEMA mice in turn; recompute size factors from the remaining ten T2 mice. Range is sensitivity, not CI.
selectionRules.ranking: Eligible before audit; same-sign leave-one-out before unstable; descending absolute descriptive effect; mouse Ensembl ID tie-break.
selectionRules.cleavageMeaning: Both flanking sites must be called in both full human and mouse proteins by the pinned upstream motif rule (default spacing 5 aa).
selectionRules.identityMeaning: Exact peptide identity without alignment gaps, separately from cleavage conservation.
selectionRules.cpmSensitivity: Counts per million uses all deposited gene counts; +1 pseudocount in CPM units. This is a qualitative normalization sensitivity check, not a second inferential test.
